method: Summon • Demon Parade • Wanted Quests • Dispatch

skills.name: Star Beam (星轨/星の軌跡)
skills.description: Susabi releases a beam of starlight to attack a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of his attack and inflicts Star Mark. ;Star Mark (星の痕) : :'''General, Mark''': Max of 5 stacks. When the stacks are at max, and if Susabi is not inflicts with control effects, all stacks are consumed to use Scourge: Star free of onibi on the the inflicted enemy.

skills.name: Stellar Field (星辰之境/日月星辰)
skills.line: "I shall punish you for entering my realm!"
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
At the start of Susabi's turn, he has a 30% chance of forming an attack-assisting field that lasts for 1 turn. While the field is active, a debuff or control effect will be dispelled at the start of his turn and he has a 50% chance to Assist. ; : ;Upon Usage :Susabi forms an attack-assisting field that lasts for 1 turn or extends the duration by an additional turn, then inflicts 3 Star Marks on an enemy. ;Star Mark (星の痕) : :'''General, Mark''': Max of 5 stacks. When the stacks are at max, and if Susabi is not inflicts with control effects, all stacks are consumed to use Scourge: Star free of onibi on the the inflicted enemy. ;Assist :When an ally uses a normal attack to attack an enemy, will also use normal attack to attack the same target

upgrades.text: Chance of forming the field increases to 50%.
Chance of forming the field increases to 60%.
Chance of forming the field increases to 100% if there are 4 or more onibi.
While the field is active, using this skill increases the move bar for all allies by 25%.

skills.name: Scourge: Star (天罚·星/天罰·星)
skills.description: Susabi summons comets to inflict 3-strikes on 1 enemy, dealing damage equal to 120% of his attack for the first strike and the damage is decreased by 10% for each subsequent strike.

upgrades.text: If the enemy is not KO'd, inflicts them with Star Mark.
If the enemy is a non-summoned entity and they're KO'd, the remaining comets inflict damage to all other enemies instead.

skills.name: Scourge: Moon (天罚·星/天罰·星)
skills.description: Susabi uses up all onibi to summon comets which inflict an equal number of strikes on 1 enemy, dealing damage equal to 120% of his attack for the first strike and the damage is decreased by 20% for each subsequent strike.

upgrades.text: If the enemy is inflicted with Star Mark, consumes all stacks of Star Mark. Each stack consumed reduces the onibi cost by 1.
If the enemy is a non-summoned entity and they're KO'd, the remaining comets inflict damage to all other enemies instead.

bio.condition: With Susabi win 50 times in PVN zones.
